selector.rationale: Extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement in a mid-wall to epicardial distribution and T2-weighted imaging suggesting myocardial edema are consistent with an inflammatory myocardial process, supporting myocarditis.

rejected.label: Cardiac Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings such as granulomas or significant lymphadenopathy

rejected.label: Acute Coronary Syndrome
rejected.why: Normal coronary angiogram was not performed but cardiac magnetic resonance imaging did not show evidence of coronary artery disease

rejected.label: Pericarditis
rejected.why: No pericardial enhancement or effusion on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging
